Laras was already an intrigueing mystery but now she is even more so and just when loose threads are promised to be neatly tied and the saga concluded we are introduced to yet another minor side mystery!<br />
How much does Laras know?<br />
What else may she be hiding and how many secrets does she have?<br />
Who are her helpers (she said she has help among the tower guards); who else has she helped escape from the tower?<br />
What are her motives for continuing her long and dangerous career of secrecy within the White Tower?<br />
Does she have links with the knitting circle and the Kin?
Did she play a role with Verin to hide the Horn of Valere?<br />
How DID she manage to make that secret kitchen basement; was the one power used?<br />
Will the reader ever learn these things? LOL<br />
